name: Stepan
bio: Stepan sits at the table, one paw draped beside a glass of wine, and stares into the middle distance with the fatigue of a cat who has seen everything twice. His deadpan toasts made him a global mood; after fleeing Kharkiv in 2022 he used his fame to raise funds for animals affected by the war in Ukraine.
awards: World Influencers and Bloggers Award, Cannes (2022)
